answer: Arrival-Ridge Admission Gate. Each new agent identity must submit its first hundred requests at a forced minimum inter-arrival gap; the gate measures the 90th-percentile gap and rejects identities whose traffic arrives in a gale of near-simultaneous bursts, forcing clones to serialize. An attacker provisioning N sybils pays N times the wall-clock delay and must hold each identity open across that ridge of enforced idleness, while honest agents absorb trivial latency. Sustained low-rate timber above threshold triggers re-measurement.
